_meta.purpose: Win-rate tuned saved strategies (NIFTY / FINNIFTY CE Buy + NIFTY option selling). Reproducible record of the exact configs that were saved to the live DB (strategies table) with their real-engine backtest results.
_meta.engine: core/services/backtest_engine.py (ENGINE_VERSION v5) + realistic fill model (0.5% slippage + 3-tick spread floor + actual charges)
notes: Win rate 95% + positive profit dono saath is data par nahi mila - 95% wale configs ka PnL negative tha (PF < 1). Ye profitable configs hain, fake 95% nahi.
Loss side ka asli source: (a) 15:15 tak hold karne par last-hour theta decay, (b) gap-through SL fills. Isliye quality entry gate + early time exit + wide (90% = practical wipe-out) SL.
SL 90% ka matlab: premium ka 90% ghata tabhi cut - intraday me rare. No-SL vs SL 90% backtest numbers identical aaye.
Paper/live me wahi SL/TP DB values use hote hain; Edit SL/TP se turant change hota hai.

BANKNIFTY #53 bhi 11-Nov ko honest engine par re-backtest hua: SL 20% config loss-making tha (-Rs32,723, 67.91% WR) - 20% SL par gap-through fills. SL 90% (user ka original 'no leg stop-loss' intent) par: 124 trades, 73.39% WR, +Rs15,220, PF 1.15. Saved result ab stale_engine=False.

saved_strategies.name: NIFTY Intraday CE Buy - 92.9% WR (Realistic BT)
saved_strategies.why: Combo A entry (EMA9/21 cross + SuperTrend green + RSI 55-65) = sirf quality intraday entries; 14:00 time exit ne last-hour decay ka loss hata diya.

saved_strategies.name: FINNIFTY Intraday CE Buy - 89.7% WR (Realistic BT)
saved_strategies.why: Opportunity Combo gate (SuperTrend+MACD+EMA+Volume) par trade count zyada (39) aur profit sabse zyada; CE-buy ke liye comboA se kaam nahi tha.

saved_strategies.name: NIFTY Option Selling PE - 92.9% WR (Realistic BT)
saved_strategies.why: Option selling me CE sell ke loss tails bahut bade the (avg_loss 4799); PE (put) selling + bearish Combo A gate + 3% TP ne same WR me profitable banaya (avg_loss 831).

key_findings: Har-bar auto signal (koi indicator nahi) par WR 69-83% aur PnL bade negative - signal quality hi asli driver hai.
TP 2-3% + time exit 13:45/14:00 = WR up, loss size down.
Trailing 'lock' (breakeven lock) scratch exits ko 'loss' dikhata hai -> WR girata hai, isliye use nahi kiya.
NIFTY CE sell (option selling) har config me negative tha; sirf PE sell profitable nikla.
SL 20% + gap fills = avg_loss 1700-5000 (catastrophic); SL 90% (wipe-out) + early exit = avg_loss 800-1700.
